settings.title: Open data services
settings.description: Weather and elevations from Open-Meteo, descriptions from Wikipedia, hotel facts from OpenStreetMap. Places and dates of your trips are sent to these services — which is why this stays off until you switch it on.
settings.switchSub: Applies to the whole instance. No account, no key.
settings.adminOnly: Only an admin can change this.
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.

planned.title: Planned elevation profile
planned.note: Ground heights from Open-Meteo along the planned line — calculated, not measured.
planned.unavailable: The elevation profile could not be computed right now – the elevation service (Open-Meteo) is not answering. Open this again later.

weather.nothing: No entry without weather has a known place.
weather.failed: The weather could not be fetched.
weather.onSave: The day's weather is fetched on save, if the trip knows a place for that day.
weather.onSaveNewDate: The new day's weather is fetched on save.
weather.noPlace: The trip knows no place with coordinates for this day — without a place there is no weather.
weather.disabled: Open data services are switched off on this instance.

outcome.futureOrToday: There is no measured weather for today or later days yet – it can be added once the day is over.
outcome.noData: The weather service has no complete measurement for this day.
outcome.timeout: The weather service did not answer in time. Please try again later.
outcome.timeoutKept: The weather service did not answer in time – the stored weather stays.
outcome.rateLimited: The weather service is not taking more requests right now. Please try again later.
outcome.rateLimitedKept: The weather service is not taking more requests right now – the stored weather stays.
outcome.unavailable: The weather service cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.
outcome.unavailableKept: The weather service cannot be reached right now – the stored weather stays.

weather.fillFailed_one: The weather service did not answer for {{count}} entry – please try again later.
weather.fillFailed_other: The weather service did not answer for {{count}} entries – please try again later.
weather.fillNoPlace_one: {{count}} entry has no place with coordinates.
weather.fillNoPlace_other: {{count}} entries have no place with coordinates.
weather.fillNotYet_one: There is no measurement yet for {{count}} entry.
weather.fillNotYet_other: There is no measurement yet for {{count}} entries.
weather.outcomeUnknown: The server no longer reports how filling in the weather ended. Please reload the trip.

wikipedia.title: From Wikipedia
wikipedia.unavailable: Wikipedia cannot be reached right now. Open this again later.

lodging.nothingNew: Found as “{{name}}” — nothing new, every field was already filled.
lodging.notFound: OpenStreetMap knows no house of this name nearby.
lodging.noCoordinates: The lodging has no coordinates, so it cannot be searched.

nearby.nothingNew: Picked “{{name}}” — nothing new, the fields were already filled.
nearby.restorePin: Move the pin back to where it was

upstream.timeout: OpenStreetMap did not answer in time – whether it knows the house is still open. Please try again later.
upstream.rateLimited: OpenStreetMap is not taking more requests right now. Please try again later.
upstream.unavailable: OpenStreetMap cannot be reached right now – whether it knows the house is still open.
